notes: Optical characteristics (Section IV) specified at TOP = 0 to 70 °C; case operating temperature -20°C to +85°C (Section VI). Electrical characteristics at TOP = -20 to 85 °C. Loss budget 5 dB on SMF G.652 includes 2.5 dB optical coding gain from host RS-FEC (528,514); maximum informative link length 2 km; RS-FEC bypass not supported; loss budget may include up to 1 dB MPI loss penalty. TDP max 3 dB does not include MPI penalty. Unstressed receiver sensitivity at 5x10^-5 BER; stressed SRS measured with 4WDM MSA conformance test signal at TP3 for 5x10^-5 BER. Power consumption ≤ 4.5 W when stabilized (Tx and Rx CDR locked); may be ≤ 5 W during locking acquisition. Section V references FTLC9555F Fibre Channel (appears inconsistent with FTLC1155RGPL3 product). Transmit OMA per Lane @TDP max: -2 dBm at maximum TDP. Average launch power of OFF transmitter per lane max -30 dBm.
